Answer: F
Reason: The pre-operative chest X-ray (Figure 1a) shows a large right-sided mediastinal mass causing significant displacement of the trachea to the left and compression/shift of the heart. The post-operative image (Figure 1c) demonstrates resolution of the mass with return of the trachea and mediastinal structures to their normal midline alignment, confirming that both were displaced and subsequently realigned.
